corrections.reason: The Ethiopic numeral ፴ (30, with its double top loop) was misread as ፳ (20); the canonical cross-reference for Jesus standing before Pilate is John 18:33 (ዮሐ ፲፰ ፴፫).
7th-order ቦ in the Ge'ez textual variant 'ቦሙ ልማድ' ('they had a custom', contrasted with 'ወቦ ልማድ ለመስፍን' and glossed below as 'ለሕዝቡ ልማድ ነበራቸው') was misread as 1st-order በ.
In the canonical Ge'ez text of Matthew 27:19, the imperative with enclitic particle is 'ዑቅኬ' ('Take heed then'); the 5th-order ኬ was misread as እ.
